annotations.title: Readiness and how to improve it

description: Use this when the connected learner asks about their readiness score, how it is built, how to raise it, or which sprint or exam to retake for the most points. Returns CertArc's Readiness Score with its parts, the points Within reach on finished work and Still ahead in sessions not taken, the Improve your score steps with links to each module's results in CertArc, and the weekly readiness trend when CertArc has recorded it. A study measure, not an exam prediction.

program.description: Certification to read. Omit for the one the learner studied most recently; every result names its certification and lists the learner's others.
